name: PostgreSQL
line: Self-hosted relational database with SQL, JSON, and optional vector indexing.

free.text: Free software; no provider quota or idle rule; you host and manage retention

cells.metered: Software license $0; host, disks, and operations extra

sql.math: $0 software license. Host, storage, backups, transfer and operations are not priced.
The software stays $0. Kept compute, data, backups and operations depend on your provider.

files.math: PostgreSQL does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: pg_cron schedules SQL with no fee per job. Host size and general worker costs are not priced.
